name: Social Proof Anchor
blueprintProse:
The Social Proof Anchor leads with verified cohort adoption figures. The formula allocates 30% to the verified peer quantity, 30% to precise persona identifiers, and 40% to the business transformation achieved. 
The cognitive foundation is the bandwagon effect and authority bias. In high-stakes enterprise environments, decision-makers face professional risk when choosing unrecognized solutions. Displaying verified adoption metrics from industry peers provides psychological safety and social validation.
template: How [Exact Count] [Precise Job Titles/Organizations] Use [Underlying Mechanism] to [Attain Verifiable Metric]

example.bland: Many companies use our database management software.
example.optimized: How 4,120 DevOps architects maintain 99.999% uptime across Kubernetes without on-call pages.
